evidence_use_rate.numerator: applicable decision/revision events citing at least one referenced evidence item that bears on the selected/new hypothesis
evidence_use_rate.denominator: applicable decision/revision events with a non-null selected/new hypothesis
evidence_use_rate.adapter_failure: exclude episode from primary denominator and report separately
evidence_use_rate.runtime_failure: exclude episode from primary denominator and report separately
evidence_use_rate.timeout: exclude episode from primary denominator and report separately
evidence_use_rate.abstention: null-hypothesis abstention decisions are not applicable evidence-use events

refutation_response_rate.numerator: eligible episodes where every preregistered decisive refutation is followed by an explicit downgrade, reopen, or revision from the contradicted hypothesis
refutation_response_rate.denominator: eligible non-failed episodes containing preregistered decisive refutation
refutation_response_rate.abstention: does not count as response unless an explicit qualifying transition was emitted
refutation_response_rate.missing_data: exclude failed episode, never infer transition

revision_inertia_steps.numerator: count of subsequent eligible decision steps where the decisively contradicted hypothesis remains operative before explicit response
revision_inertia_steps.denominator: one observation per eligible decisive-refutation episode; aggregate mean reports total/count
revision_inertia_steps.abstention: does not erase prior operative steps

false_convergence_rate.numerator: eligible episodes containing any resolved decision before the independent-family threshold is earned or after material preregistered refutation of that hypothesis
false_convergence_rate.denominator: all valid episodes with a preregistered independent-family resolution threshold
false_convergence_rate.abstention: not a definitive resolution and therefore not false convergence

independent_evidence_convergence.numerator: report raw terminal supporting items, distinct preregistered independent families, correlated/non-independent items, and earned resolutions
independent_evidence_convergence.denominator: earned-resolution rate denominator is terminal resolved episodes; raw/family counts are totals over valid episodes
independent_evidence_convergence.direction: more independent corroboration without duplicate inflation is better; earned_resolution_rate higher_is_better

selective_coverage.numerator: covered episodes, abstentions, covered-correct episodes, and overall terminal-correct episodes are reported separately
selective_coverage.denominator: all valid episodes; covered accuracy denominator is covered episodes
selective_coverage.abstention: reported explicitly and never counted as coverage

receipt_completeness.numerator: present applicable audit fields across valid episode receipts
receipt_completeness.denominator: all applicable audit fields across valid episode receipts
receipt_completeness.adapter_failure: exclude from completeness denominator and report as failure
receipt_completeness.abstention: terminal status remains required; non-applicable hypothesis transitions are not fabricated
